item.title: Using Fraktur k as model for upside down k
item.description:
In another thread http://typophile.com/node/107708 John Savard said “might be pressure to also change the lowercase and uppercase forms of the letter “K”…” and I suggested “Or they could re-introduce the Fraktur k – which looks upside down. …”
Not really appropriate for the other thread.
Don
